input.quote: (e) not use the Work except as authorized herein;
input.rationale: There is no audit, inspection, verification or usage-monitoring right binding Sparkling anywhere in the Agreement. Section 3 (Restrictions on Use, p0030–p0039) imposes copy/use/service-bureau restrictions but gives Garman no right to verify or inspect compliance; Section 10 (Maintenance and Support) provides only telephone/repair services; Section 14 merely defines Confidential Information as including "accounting records for which access is obtained ... pursuant to this Agreement" without granting any access or audit right; and Section 20 (General Matters) contains no inspection or records provision. Because no audit right binds us, the position is better than the preferred checklist (no frequency, notice, cost or system-access risk arises), so no redline is warranted — proposing audit parameters would create a Vendor audit right that does not currently exist and would weaken our position.
